paper.title: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
paper.authors: Zheng-Hang Sun, Christopher Roth, Ao Chen, Markus Heyl

results.system_description: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the kagome lattice, 6 x 6 unit cells (108 sites), rhombic torus with a1 = (1, 0), a2 = (1/2, sqrt(3)/2); total Sz = 0
results.variant: n = c = 32 (residual blocks = channels), Gamma point, even spin inversion, D6 point-group projection
results.source_location: Table tab:energy (main text), row L = 6, column c = n = 32, e
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of the authors' own kagome message-passing residual network (KagomeResNet) with a fixed q = 0 reference phase, optimized by MinSR and evaluated by VMC with ergodic sampling.
results.notes: H = sum_<ij> S_i . S_j with spin-1/2 operators (Eq. 1); periodic L x L torus, N = 3 L^2, primitive vectors a1 = (1, 0), a2 = (1/2, sqrt(3)/2) (SM, reciprocal-lattice section), the cluster of the instance. The amplitude is multiplied by the fixed coplanar q = 0 three-sublattice phase, a closed-form sign prior (not an exact sign structure); the network also learns phase corrections. States in the Gamma-point sector with even spin inversion I_s = +1, which fixes total Sz = 0, after translation-only training and a D6 point-group projection. The paper does not state the meaning of the parenthesized error, recorded as unspecified. The variance is the printed energy-variance density sigma^2 (per site). The text also prints the total -47.1597(6) of this state (Fig. 1d), not entered separately. The projected-RVB and PEPS energies quoted in the text are from other papers.
